capabilities: simulate all dice formulas on the current page
average all dice formulas on the current page
find dice formulas anywhere in the active note via commands
assign hotkeys and ribbon icons to the dice commands
extras: Manual installation instructions suggest it may not be in the community plugin store; README references screenshots that show results but are not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll or average dice formulas written in a note, which tabletop players need during sessions.
summary: Dice roller that finds dice formulas like 1d10+2d6+4 in the active note and simulates or averages them on command.
